full_prompt_en: A square color photograph shows two small pedestrians crossing a wet urban roadway into dense blue-gray rain and fog. The view is from street level, looking toward a row of tall office towers that rise through the background but nearly disappear in the weather. Their rectangular window grids are faintly visible through the haze; one tower near the center has a rounded upper profile. The sky and buildings merge into a single cold slate-blue field. In the lower middle, the two pedestrians appear as almost black silhouettes. The person on the left walks without a visible cover, while the one on the right holds a dark umbrella. Both move away from the camera, leaving long narrow reflections on the glossy pavement. Several cars face the viewer in the middle distance, their bright headlamps diffused into soft white circles and streaked vertically on the road. A smaller warm amber reflection runs down the right half from a suspended streetlight. Curving lamp posts frame the left approach, while an overhead traffic signal and a few dark vehicles mark the right side. The road surface is uneven with shallow puddles and slick patches; a dark curb and railing edge the left side, and rough wet ground gathers in the near foreground. The skyline recedes layer by layer rather than ending in a sharp horizon. Rain and mist soften every distant boundary, yet the nearest figures and light reflections remain distinct. The photographic color is restrained, with petrol blue, charcoal, and muted cyan carrying most of the image, punctuated by a few warm orange lamps. The heavy atmosphere makes the bright points bloom and reduces the broad architecture to ghostly vertical masses. The composition gives the empty reflective foreground great weight, then leads the eye through the two modest silhouettes and luminous traffic into the fading city.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形彩色照片呈现两名矮小行人穿过潮湿城市道路，走进浓重蓝灰色雨雾中。视点位于街面高度，面向背景一排高楼；它们从远处升起，却几乎消失在天气里。矩形窗格透过雾隐约可辨，中央附近一座楼的上部轮廓较圆。天空与楼群融成同一块冷石板蓝色域。下方中部，两名行人近乎黑色剪影。左侧一人没有可见遮挡，右侧一人撑着深色伞。两人都背对相机远去，在光滑路面留下细长倒影。中景几辆车朝向观者，亮车灯经雾扩散成柔白圆点，并在路上拉出竖向光痕。一盏悬挂路灯在右半部投下更暖的琥珀色反光。弯曲灯杆框住左侧道路，悬空交通灯和几辆暗车标出右侧。路面有浅水洼与湿滑斑块；左边由暗路沿与栏杆界定，近前景聚着粗糙湿地。楼群一层层后退，而非停在清晰地平线。雨与雾软化所有远处边界，最近的人影和灯光倒影却仍有区分。摄影色彩克制，以石油蓝、炭黑和低调青色为主，少量暖橙灯光点缀。厚重空气让亮点生出光晕，也把宽阔建筑压成幽灵般竖向大块。构图给予空阔反光前景充分重量，再让视线穿过两枚小剪影和发亮车流，进入逐渐消失的城市。
style_prompt_en: Color photography uses dense rain haze, low contrast, and reflective dark planes to create depth. Cool petrol blue and slate gray cover broad areas, while a few white and muted amber points bloom into soft halos. Wet surfaces stretch these lights into broken vertical streaks, providing a narrow rhythm beneath large indistinct forms. Near silhouettes remain nearly black and readable, whereas distant grids and hard edges dissolve gradually into the atmosphere. Fine visible grain and uneven surface reflections keep the image tactile. The composition gives a wide shadowed foreground to tiny focal marks and lets large upright masses recede behind them, creating a quiet, enveloping sense of scale.
style_prompt_zh: 彩色摄影用浓密雨雾、低对比和反光的深色平面建立纵深。冷石油蓝与石板灰覆盖宽阔区域，少量白色和低调琥珀色亮点扩散成柔软光晕。潮湿表面把这些光拉成断续竖痕，在模糊大块下方形成窄小节奏。近处剪影近黑而可读，远处网格与硬边则逐渐消溶在空气中。可见细颗粒与不匀表面反光让画面可触。构图以宽阔暗前景衬托微小焦点记号，并让巨大的竖向色块在其后后退，形成安静而包围人的尺度感。
theme_en: Two pedestrians crossing a rain-soaked city road toward fogbound towers
theme_zh: 两名行人穿过雨水浸透的城市道路，走向雾中的高楼
name: Christophe Jacrot
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
